title: Pleurozium schreberi (moss) DNA extraction
author: Eric RA Pederson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7ekhjcw
materials: Pre-warm the CTAB buffer and N-lauroylsarcosine buffer.
Weigh the tissue by subtracting the tube.
Redissolve the pellet in 500 μL TE buffer.
Use pipette to discard the ethanol

steps.title: Prepare sterile workspace
steps.instruction: Clean the sterile bench and spray all lab plastic and equipment, then place them in the bench for at least 15 minutes.

steps.title: Grind moss tissue
steps.instruction: Grind the tissue using a mortar and pestle with liquid nitrogen until finely ground, then transfer the frozen ground tissue to 2 ml tubes.

steps.title: Add extraction reagents
steps.instruction: For every gram of fresh weight tissue, add the following reagents:

steps.title: Incubate and cool
steps.instruction: Mix the sample by inversion and incubate in a water bath at 60°C for 60 min, then cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Handle and store tissue
steps.instruction: Clean forceps with ethanol and burn until red; use them to transfer tissue into 2 ml tubes for immediate use or storage.

steps.title: Initial DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume of sterile 5 M ammonium acetate, mix, and incubate for 5 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture for 10 min at 15,000 g at room temperature.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA from supernatant
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA from the supernatant using 1 volume of isopropanol at -20°C for 30 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge and wash pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 30 min at 12,000 g at 4°C, wash the pellet with 70% ethanol, and dry.

steps.title: Redissolve DNA
steps.instruction: Redissolve the DNA in 1 mL TE buffer (or use milli-Q water if the DNA is intended for sequencing).

steps.title: Remove RNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 μL of RNAse stock and incubate at 37°C for 15 min.

steps.title: Perform chloroform-isoamyl alcohol extractions
steps.instruction: Perform two extractions using 1 volume of chloroform-isoamyl alcohol (24:1).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to the sample.
Vortex for 1 minute and centrifuge for 10 min at 12,000 g at 4°C.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a fresh tube.
Repeat the process: add 1 volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), vortex for 1 minute, and centrifuge for 10 min at 12,000 g at 4°C.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Remove residual chloroform
steps.instruction: Remove any transferred chloroform by centrifuging for 10 seconds at top speed, then remove the bottom phase.

steps.title: Final DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA from the aqueous phase with 1 volume of isopropanol.

steps.title: Final centrifugation and wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 30 min at 12,000 g at 4°C and wash the pellet with 70% ethanol.

steps.title: Dry and recover DNA
steps.instruction: Air dry the pellet to ensure ethanol is gone (do not overdry), then redissolve in 1 mL TE buffer (or milli-Q water if intended for sequencing).
